description: FFmpeg is a cross-platform multimedia framework for decoding, encoding, transcoding, muxing, demuxing, and streaming audio and video in virtually any format. This JavaCPP Presets module generates Java bindings for FFmpeg's native libraries (libavcodec, libavformat, libavutil, libswscale, and others), letting JVM applications call its C APIs directly through JNI without writing custom native-interop code.
